instrument: Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 and the PMLA Rules administered by FIU-IND
requirement: Report suspicious transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit - India within the prescribed window after suspicion is determined, and maintain the records that support the determination.
control_name: Suspicious activity detection and case file
verification_note: Day-count for filing is set by current FIU-IND guidance and changes; confirm the live timeline with compliance before quoting it.

instrument: RBI Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Directions 2016 as updated and consolidated
requirement: Undertake customer identification, ongoing due diligence and re-verification where circumstances cast doubt on previously obtained identifiers.
control_name: Triggered re-KYC queue
verification_note: Consolidated KYC direction reissued by RBI in 2024; cite the version your compliance team holds.

instrument: RBI Master Direction - Fraud and Cyber Fraud Reporting in Customer Interfaced Products
requirement: Report fraud on customer-interfaced digital products through the prescribed channels, appoint a fraud nodal officer, and compensate customers within the timelines set for disputed electronic transactions.
control_name: Fraud case register and customer escalation log
verification_note: Reimbursement day-counts differ by product and by whether the amount was debited; treat the specific numbers as a counsel check, not a repo claim.

instrument: RBI Guidelines on Regulation of Operators of Payment Systems (Payment Gateways and Aggregators)
requirement: Monitor, escalate and report fraud on the payment system, maintain a customer redressal mechanism, and keep the regulator informed of material incidents.
control_name: Payment fraud monitoring pack
verification_note: Applies to registered PA/PG entities; the repo produces the monitoring pack, not the registration.

instrument: RBI Master Direction - Digital Lending Products (August 2023)
requirement: Maintain an audit trail of loan-related instructions, a risk-based internal control framework, and an appropriate customer grievance mechanism.
control_name: Funds-movement integrity check on post-takeover drawdown
verification_note: Relevant when the institution lends: an ATO that draws credit is a different liability from an ATO that only spends.

instrument: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 section 8(6) and the rules notified under it
requirement: Intimate a personal data breach to the Data Protection Board and to affected data principals in the prescribed manner and content.
control_name: Breach impact assessment and affected-subject count
verification_note: The Act is in force with phased compliance dates; notice format and timing come from the notified rules and Board communications.

instrument: Information Technology Act 2000 section 43A
requirement: Maintain reasonable security practices and procedures over sensitive personal data or the entity is exposed to compensation for wrongful loss.
control_name: Documented control set with evidence of operation
verification_note: Section 43A is enforced through contractual and adjudication routes rather than a certification.

instrument: SEBI Cyber Security and Cyber Resilience Framework for the Indian securities market
requirement: Report cyber security incidents to SEBI within the stipulated timeframe and maintain an information security management system.
control_name: Incident reporting readiness
verification_note: Included for breadth only. Applies to recognised market infrastructure and intermediaries, not to a general payments T and S programme.
check: out of scope, listed for breadth

instrument: PSD2 Article 97 and Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2018/389 on strong customer authentication
requirement: Apply strong customer authentication to electronic remote payments and to online access to a payment account, with documented use of any exemption.
control_name: Step-up authentication on first-seen device
verification_note: RTS 2018/389 also governs exemption monitoring - this is the control that SCA telemetry is measured against.

instrument: PSD2 Articles 95 and 96
requirement: Keep records of non-authorised or fraudulent transactions, and supply the payer with the information and reasoning supporting a refund decision.
control_name: Fraud transaction register and refund rationale
verification_note: Article numbering is stable; refund deadlines are set in the national transposition of each member state.

instrument: GDPR Articles 33 and 34
requirement: Notify a personal data breach to the supervisory authority without undue delay and no later than 72 hours where feasible, and communicate to data subjects when high risk.
control_name: Breach impact assessment and affected-subject count
verification_note: The 72-hour figure is statutory and safe to cite; the risk threshold for communicating to subjects is a judgement the DPO owns.

instrument: DORA Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 Article 19
requirement: Classify and report major ICT-related incidents to the competent authority in initial, intermediate and final reports within the prescribed hours.
control_name: Incident reporting readiness
verification_note: Applies to financial entities in scope of DORA. Initial-report timing is set by the RTS on ICT incident classification and reporting.

instrument: PSR reimbursement requirement for authorised push payment scams and contingent reimbursement for reimbursable scams (in force 7 October 2024)
requirement: Pay firms must reimburse victims of reimbursable scams subject to the exception and claim rules, and report the scheme data to the PSR.
control_name: Liability-aware exposure model
verification_note: This is the clearest example of a regulatory change turning detection quality directly into balance-sheet cost.

instrument: FCA SYSC and operational resilience rules (PS21/3 with policy statements on important business services)
requirement: Identify important business services, set impact tolerances, and evidence resilience including against financial-crime harm.
control_name: Documented control set with evidence of operation
verification_note: The impact tolerance belongs to the firm; the repo shows how a queue capacity constraint is stated against one.

instrument: Bank Secrecy Act 31 CFR 1010.320 (SAR filing)
requirement: File a suspicious activity report within 30 calendar days of initial detection of facts that may constitute a basis for filing.
control_name: Suspicious activity detection and case file
verification_note: The 30-day clock runs from detection, which is why detection time is captured per case rather than per report.

instrument: Regulation E 12 CFR 1005.6 1005.11 and 1005.13
requirement: Investigate an asserted error within the prescribed periods, provide provisional credit where the investigation runs long, and apply the tiered consumer liability limits.
control_name: Fraud case register and customer escalation log
verification_note: Reg E is the US analogue of the RBI customer-protection timelines; the two are not interchangeable in detail.

instrument: FTC Safeguards Rule 16 CFR part 314
requirement: Maintain a written information security programme including an incident response plan, and notify the FTC of a security event involving unencrypted customer information of a sufficient number of consumers.
control_name: Documented control set with evidence of operation
verification_note: Applies to non-bank financial institutions; the notification threshold is a count of consumers rather than a dollar value.

instrument: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 8 (identification, authentication and access management) and Requirement 12.10 (incident response)
requirement: MFA where not otherwise exempted, protection against credential stuffing through password strength and reuse checks, monitoring for anomalous account behaviour, and a tested incident response procedure.
control_name: Authentication hardening and anomalous account monitoring
verification_note: Requirement 8 is the clause most directly aimed at account takeover; it is contractual through the acquirer rather than statutory.

jurisdiction: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand
instrument: FinCEN CISA FBI joint advisory on account takeover through remote access tools (January 2023)
requirement: Recognise the RAT-enabled takeover typology: victim is socially engineered into installing access tooling, then fraudulent wires and new-device activity follow.
control_name: Typology library coverage
verification_note: Included as the canonical typology reference for the RCA stage model rather than as a filing obligation.

instrument: NIST SP 800-63B Digital Identity Guidelines
requirement: Rate-limit authentication attempts, throttle or lock out after sustained failures, and check candidate credentials against known-breach corpora before accepting them.
control_name: Credential-stuffing throttle and breach-credential screening
verification_note: 800-63B is the most specific published control for the credential-stuffing pattern this dataset injects.

instrument: ISO/IEC 27001 2022 Annex A (authentication information, secure authentication, incident management)
requirement: Control authentication information, monitor for anomalous privileged-user behaviour, and operate an incident management process.
control_name: Documented control set with evidence of operation
verification_note: Certification bodies audit the operating evidence, which is what the control evidence index is for.

instrument: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard - authentication and session management
requirement: Verify credential-entry resistance, session invalidation on authentication change, and no reuse of session identifiers after a password change.
control_name: Session invalidation on credential reset
verification_note: Directly relevant to the RCA finding that a password reset alone did not terminate active sessions.

instrument: FATF Recommendations 15 and 16 and the risk-based approach
requirement: Apply AML and CFT controls to new payment products and correspondent relationships, calibrated to assessed risk.
control_name: Suspicious activity detection and case file
verification_note: Self-as-regulator reference point; the repo does not claim a FATF assessment.

instrument: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 functions DET (Detect) and RSI (Respond and Recover)
requirement: Detect events continuously, analyse them for impact and scope, and respond with a prioritised and communicated action.
control_name: Detection monitoring and response runbook
verification_note: The monitoring artefacts are the DET evidence; the runbook is the RSI evidence.
